title: "Congratulations to 2026 PhD graduates David Grace and Devin Gill"
date: 2026-09-14
description: "The lab celebrates two doctoral graduates in 2026."
categories: [People]
---

Congratulations to **David Grace, PhD** and **Devin Gill, PhD**, who completed their doctoral degrees in 2026.

David's research examined religion, values, institutions, and sustainability outcomes, including forest governance and decision-making. Devin's work focused on actionable climate knowledge, co-production, equity, and the scaling of community engagement in climate adaptation.
